_about.captured: 2026-10-13, app.sanoflow.io, Al Das workspace, by the owner's logged-in browser session at the owner's request
_about.method: Read-only GET of 129 data-source endpoints (no mutations, no AI/export/sync/payment calls), limit=3 per list. Each JSON response was reduced IN THE BROWSER to field paths and value types; values never left the page. Object keys that looked like data (digits, emails, long strings) were replaced with <key>.
_about.how_to_read: fields maps path to type; [] marks array elements; required_params lists the params an endpoint rejected the request for (HTTP 400), which tells you its record key. 500/403 endpoints need a record context and were not resolved.
_about.excluded: Sanoflow's own SaaS billing endpoints (Settings/company/Billing/*) were captured but left out as irrelevant to Pulse.
_about.security_note: Sanoflow returns channel access tokens (page_access_token, user_access_token, account_token, account_key) and users' pass_reset_token to the browser. Pulse must never do this (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
